benchmarks.note: p chained K_4 cliques (p = 3/5/8) joined by single bridge edges. Each clique is a cohesion-3 block inside the cohesion-1 whole, so the block count grows linearly in p; every queue entry pays a vertex_connectivity plus a full minimum_size_separators (Kanevsky) call. Cost is dominated by the per-block max-flow / min-cut enumeration multiplied by the number of blocks discovered (~10x per step here)

m x m square lattice (m = 3/4/5), connectivity 2 with a clustered flow structure; stresses the separator + reduction pipeline on each block. Super-linear growth driven by the per-block Kanevsky minimum_size_separators enumeration on a denser interior (degree-4 vertices)
